design.onChainRole: commitments, verifier policy, challenge replay protection, proof receipts and eligibility state

invariants: STORAGE-PROOF-INV-001: only active 420Store nodes belonging to active staked Resource Protocol providers may originate storage commitments
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-002: storage commitment identity is single-use and its provider, node, proof scheme, roots, byte size and time bounds are immutable after registration
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-003: proof schemes are versioned by immutable ids and require default-deny capability authorization to register or deactivate
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-004: a proof challenge must fall within the referenced storage commitment time interval
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-005: a commitment/challenge pair may produce at most one accepted proof receipt
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-006: proof acceptance fails closed when the store node or proof scheme is inactive, the verifier reverts, verification returns false, or the proof deadline is exceeded
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-007: accepted proof bytes are not retained on-chain; only a proof digest and canonical receipt metadata are stored
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-008: proof verification does not itself release payment; settlement modules consume verified proof state under separate accounting rules
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-009: encrypted user payloads, erasure-coded shards and private metadata remain off-chain
STORAGE-PROOF-INV-010: proof scheme verifiers are replaceable only by registering a new scheme id, preserving historical proof reproducibility
futureExtensions: proof aggregation and succinct verifier adapters
